captures.description: THE SCHOENBERG DATABASE OF MANUSCRIPTS, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a free, open-access, crowd-sourced digital research tool hosted by the Schoenberg Institute for Manuscript Studies at Penn Libraries.' Purpose (trace pre-modern manuscripts from creation to the present), scale ('over 240,000 manuscript observation records gathered from more. than 14,000' catalogues and inventories), period (500 to 1600) and region, export in .xlsx and .csv, and five record types (sources, entries, manuscript records, name authority, place authority). Eight cards: Medieval Digital Resources, Penn Libraries (three), a Bibliographical Society of America video, AWOL, Penn Press, Aalto's Semantic Computing Research Group.

atoms.evidence: hosted by the [Schoenberg Institute for Manuscript Studies]
Contains over 240,000 manuscript observation records gathered from more. than 14,000 auction catalogs, sales records, institutional inventories, and private collections.
Purpose: Allows scholars, collectors, and researchers to trace the history and provenance of pre-modern manuscripts from their creation to the present.
Access & Formats: Free to use without a fee
data is searchable, browsable, and exportable in `.xlsx` and `.csv` formats
